title: Transmission Modes: Parallel and Serial
keyPoints: Parallel: multiple bits per clock tick; serial: one bit per clock tick (slide 66).
Asynchronous: 1 start bit (0), one or more stop bits (1s), possible gaps between bytes (slide 70).
Asynchronous at the byte level, but bits are still synchronized (slide 71).
Synchronous: bits sent one after another with no start/stop bits or gaps; receiver groups the bits (slide 73).
